title: Enter the teaching as given
summary: Even the doorway into the teaching is received, not self-composed. Let the received opening steady you before you turn spirituality into another performance.
takeaway: Receive the doorway as grace before trying to design the path.
lifeApplication: When you are too tired to manufacture devotion, stop manufacturing. Enter by the words already given and let grace carry the first step.

source.shortMeaning: Even the doorway into the teaching is received, not self-composed.
source.lifeApplication: Before beginning, receive the path as given instead of improvising yourself into it.
